verdict.rationale: The repo registers as a plugin marketplace, so you can install the `document-skills` or `example-skills` plugin separately, and the Messages API lets you pick individual skills by `skill_id` (e.g. `pptx`, `pdf`). But in Claude Code a plugin installs and loads as one unit, so first-party selection inside a plugin bundle is not documented. The single-skill install in the probe used third-party `npx skills` tooling, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party per-skill install from the anthropics/skills collection in Claude Code, and independent corroboration of granular selection with first-party tooling.
